mapper.select: SELECT CAST(#{owner} AS BIGINT) FROM (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(-CAST(#{owner} AS BIGINT))) locked
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_wrk_ntf_stg(mbr_acct_idx,rcpt_email,created_by) VALUES(#{owner},#{email},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(mbr_acct_idx) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, wrk_ntf_stg_idx AS idx, wrk_ntf_stg_uuid AS uuid FROM tb_wrk_ntf_stg s WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND del_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_stg SET rcpt_email=#{s.rcptEmail},vrfd_at=#{s.vrfdAt},vrfy_hash=#{s.vrfyHash}, vrfy_expires_at=#{s.vrfyExpiresAt},vrfy_sent_at=#{s.vrfySentAt},vrfy_tries=#{s.vrfyTries}, vrfy_window_at=#{s.vrfyWindowAt},vrfy_count=#{s.vrfyCount},dgst_enabled=#{s.dgstEnabled}, rmd_enabled=#{s.rmdEnabled},tm_zone=#{s.tmZone},dgst_time=#{s.dgstTime},dgst_cycle=#{s.dgstCycle}, next_dgst_at=#{s.nextDgstAt},ver=#{s.ver},updated_by=#{s.updatedBy},updated_at=now() WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{s.mbrAcctIdx} AND del_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: t.*, t.wrk_todo_idx AS idx,t.wrk_todo_uuid AS uuid,u.work_unit_uuid,u.ttl AS work_unit_ttl, (u.use_yn='Y' AND u.del_at IS NULL) AS active, NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_todo c WHERE c.prnt_wrk_todo_idx=t.wrk_todo_idx AND c.work_unit_idx=t.work_unit_idx AND c.mbr_acct_idx=t.mbr_acct_idx AND c.del_at IS NULL) AS leaf
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_wrk_todo t JOIN tb_work_unit u ON u.work_unit_idx=t.work_unit_idx AND u.mbr_acct_idx=t.mbr_acct_idx WHERE t.wrk_todo_uuid=CAST(#{todoUuid} AS UUID) AND t.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND t.del_at IS NULL AND u.del_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM tb_wrk_todo_rmd r JOIN tb_wrk_todo t ON t.wrk_todo_idx=r.wrk_todo_idx AND t.mbr_acct_idx=r.mbr_acct_idx JOIN tb_work_unit u ON u.work_unit_idx=t.work_unit_idx AND u.mbr_acct_idx=t.mbr_acct_idx WHERE r.wrk_todo_rmd_idx=#{reminderId} AND r.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND t.del_at IS NULL AND u.del_at IS NULL
SELECT r.*,wrk_todo_rmd_idx AS idx,wrk_todo_rmd_uuid AS uuid FROM tb_wrk_todo_rmd r WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND wrk_todo_idx=#{todoId} AND del_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_wrk_todo_rmd(mbr_acct_idx,wrk_todo_idx,send_at,strt_dt,due_dt,created_by) VALUES(#{r.mbrAcctIdx},#{r.wrkTodoIdx},#{r.sendAt},#{r.strtDt},#{r.dueDt},#{r.createdBy}) ON CONFLICT(wrk_todo_idx) DO UPDATE SET send_at=EXCLUDED.send_at,enabled=TRUE, ver=tb_wrk_todo_rmd.ver+1,strt_dt=EXCLUDED.strt_dt,due_dt=EXCLUDED.due_dt, updated_by=EXCLUDED.created_by,updated_at=now() WHERE tb_wrk_todo_rmd.mbr_acct_idx=EXCLUDED.mbr_acct_idx
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_wrk_todo_rmd SET enabled=FALSE,ver=ver+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=now() WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND wrk_todo_idx=#{todoId} AND enabled
UPDATE tb_wrk_todo_rmd SET enabled=enabled AND NOT #{disable} AND send_at>now(), ver=ver+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=now() WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND enabled

UPDATE tb_wrk_todo_rmd r SET enabled=FALSE,ver=ver+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=now() WHERE r.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND r.enabled AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_todo t JOIN tb_work_unit u ON u.work_unit_idx=t.work_unit_idx AND u.mbr_acct_idx=t.mbr_acct_idx WHERE t.wrk_todo_idx=r.wrk_todo_idx AND t.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND t.sts!='DONE' AND t.del_at IS NULL AND u.del_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn='Y' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_todo c WHERE c.prnt_wrk_todo_idx=t.wrk_todo_idx AND c.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND c.work_unit_idx=t.work_unit_idx AND c.del_at IS NULL))

UPDATE tb_wrk_todo_rmd r SET strt_dt=t.strt_dt,due_dt=t.due_dt,ver=r.ver+1, enabled=r.send_at>now(),updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=now() FROM tb_wrk_todo t WHERE r.wrk_todo_idx=t.wrk_todo_idx AND r.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND t.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND r.enabled AND (r.strt_dt IS DISTINCT FROM t.strt_dt OR r.due_dt IS DISTINCT FROM t.due_dt)

UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr d SET sts='CANCELLED',result_cd='INVALIDATED',updated_at=now() WHERE d.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND d.sts IN ('PENDING','RETRY','CLAIMED') AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_ntf_stg s JOIN tb_mbr_acct a ON a.mbr_acct_idx=s.mbr_acct_idx WHERE s.mbr_acct_idx=d.mbr_acct_idx AND s.del_at IS NULL AND s.vrfd_at IS NOT NULL AND s.ver=d.stg_ver AND a.del_at IS NULL AND a.acct_stat='ACTIVE' AND ((d.kind='DIGEST' AND s.dgst_enabled) OR (d.kind='REMINDER' AND s.rmd_enabled AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tb_wrk_todo_rmd r WHERE r.wrk_todo_rmd_idx=d.wrk_todo_rmd_idx AND r.mbr_acct_idx=d.mbr_acct_idx AND r.enabled AND r.ver=d.rmd_ver))))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr(mbr_acct_idx,wrk_todo_rmd_idx,kind,dedup_key,stg_ver,rmd_ver,due_at,next_try_at,created_by) SELECT r.mbr_acct_idx,r.wrk_todo_rmd_idx,'REMINDER','R:'||r.wrk_todo_rmd_uuid||':'||r.ver, s.ver,r.ver,r.send_at,r.send_at,r.created_by FROM tb_wrk_todo_rmd r JOIN tb_wrk_ntf_stg s ON s.mbr_acct_idx=r.mbr_acct_idx WHERE r.mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND r.enabled AND s.rmd_enabled AND s.vrfd_at IS NOT NULL AND s.del_at IS NULL AND r.del_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT(mbr_acct_idx,dedup_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT mbr_acct_idx FROM tb_wrk_ntf_stg WHERE dgst_enabled AND vrfd_at IS NOT NULL AND del_at IS NULL AND next_dgst_at<=now() ORDER BY next_dgst_at,mbr_acct_idx LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr(mbr_acct_idx,kind,dedup_key,stg_ver,due_at,next_try_at,created_by) VALUES(#{s.mbrAcctIdx},'DIGEST',#{key},#{s.ver},#{dueAt},#{dueAt},#{s.createdBy}) ON CONFLICT(mbr_acct_idx,dedup_key) DO UPDATE SET stg_ver=EXCLUDED.stg_ver,due_at=EXCLUDED.due_at, next_try_at=EXCLUDED.next_try_at,sts='PENDING',result_cd=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr.sts='CANCELLED' AND tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr.attempts=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM leaf_todos WHERE todo_group IN ('TODAY','OVERDUE') OR (todo_group='UPCOMING' AND due_dt<=#{req.today}+3) ORDER BY COALESCE(due_dt,strt_dt),idx LIMIT 201

WITH candidates AS (SELECT wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx FROM tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr WHERE sts IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_try_at<=now() ORDER BY next_try_at,wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr d SET sts='CLAIMED',claim_token=gen_random_uuid(), lease_until=now()+INTERVAL '2 minutes',updated_at=now() FROM candidates c WHERE d.wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx=c.wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx RETURNING d.*,d.wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx AS idx,d.wrk_ntf_dlvr_uuid AS uuid
SELECT d.*,wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx AS idx,wrk_ntf_dlvr_uuid AS uuid FROM tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr d WHERE wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr SET sts='SENDING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_until=now()+INTERVAL '10 minutes',updated_at=now() WHERE wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx=#{id} AND claim_token=CAST(#{token} AS UUID) AND sts='CLAIMED' AND lease_until>now()

UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr SET sts=#{status},result_cd=#{code},next_try_at=COALESCE(#{nextTry},next_try_at), sent_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='SENT' THEN now() ELSE sent_at END,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx=#{id} AND claim_token=CAST(#{token} AS UUID) AND sts='SENDING'
UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr SET sts='CANCELLED',result_cd=#{code},updated_at=now() WHERE wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx=#{id} AND claim_token=CAST(#{token} AS UUID) AND sts='CLAIMED'
UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr SET sts='RETRY',claim_token=NULL,next_try_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE sts='CLAIMED' AND lease_until<now()
UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr SET sts='UNKNOWN',result_cd='PROCESS_INTERRUPTED',updated_at=now() WHERE sts='SENDING' AND lease_until<now()
UPDATE tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr SET sts='FAILED',result_cd='EXPIRED',updated_at=now() WHERE sts IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND due_at<now()-INTERVAL '24 hours'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_mbr_acct WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} AND del_at IS NULL AND acct_stat='ACTIVE')
SELECT d.*,wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx AS idx,wrk_ntf_dlvr_uuid AS uuid FROM tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr d WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner} ORDER BY created_at DESC,wrk_ntf_dlvr_idx DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_wrk_ntf_dlvr WHERE mbr_acct_idx=#{owner}
